qa_pairs.instruction: What types of properties are unique to the Delimited Text driver?
qa_pairs.output: The Delimited Text driver has two types of unique properties: Driver Configuration properties and Global Configuration Values (GCV) properties. All other driver properties such as Named Password, Engine Control Values, and Log Level are common to all drivers and are documented in the NetIQ Identity Manager Driver Administration Guide.

qa_pairs.instruction: From which tool's perspective are the Delimited Text driver properties documented?
qa_pairs.output: The properties information for the Delimited Text driver is presented from the viewpoint of Identity Console. When a field differs in Designer, it is marked with a Designer icon to indicate the difference.

qa_pairs.instruction: Summarize the structure of the Delimited Text driver properties documentation.
qa_pairs.output: The Delimited Text driver properties documentation covers two unique property categories: Driver Configuration and Global Configuration Values. These are the only properties specific to the Delimited Text driver; all other properties (Named Password, Engine Control Values, Log Level, etc.) are common across all Identity Manager drivers and are documented separately in the NetIQ Identity Manager Driver Administration Guide. The properties are documented from the Identity Console perspective, with Designer differences noted by icons.
